privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Mapsly collects, uses, shares, and protects your information.
privacy.s1_p1: Mapsly is a local business intelligence platform operated by Mapsly, Inc. ("Mapsly", "we", "us"). We help small businesses understand their online presence and help marketing agencies find qualified local prospects. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and your rights over it.
privacy.s1_p2: If you have questions, contact us at privacy@mapsly.ai. We respond to all privacy inquiries within 30 days.
privacy.s2_p1: We collect information you provide directly, information we collect automatically, and information from public sources about local businesses you (or your agency) research on Mapsly.
privacy.s2_b1: Account information: name, email address, and locale preference. For agency seats, we also store your team membership and role.
privacy.s2_b2: Business information: if you operate an SMB on Mapsly, we store your business name, address, category, Google CID, and the public profile data we refresh weekly on your behalf.
privacy.s2_b3: Usage data: anonymous telemetry about which pages you visit, which filters you apply, and how features perform. Used to improve the product. No keystroke or input recording.
privacy.s2_b4: Payment information: handled by Stripe. We never see or store your full card number — only a token, last 4 digits, and billing country.
privacy.s2_p2: Mapsly is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 16. If you believe we have, email privacy@mapsly.ai and we will delete it promptly.
privacy.s3_p1: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.s3_b1: Provide the service — show your dashboard, refresh your business data, generate prospect lists.
privacy.s3_b2: Authenticate you — verify magic-link sign-ins via email.
privacy.s3_b3: Charge your subscription — via Stripe, on the plan you selected.
privacy.s3_b4: Send transactional email — weekly check-ins, billing receipts, security notices. Not marketing.
privacy.s3_b5: Improve the product — aggregated, anonymized usage trends.
privacy.s3_b6: Comply with law — tax, accounting, and lawful requests from authorities.
privacy.s4_p1: We use a small set of vetted vendors to operate Mapsly. Each only receives the data they need to perform their role: Stripe (payments), Resend (transactional email), DataForSEO (public business data refresh), Anthropic (AI review reply drafts), Sentry (error monitoring), and Vercel (hosting). We do not sell or rent your personal information to anyone.
privacy.s4_p2: If we ever need to add a new vendor that processes personal data, we will update this policy and post a changelog at the top.
privacy.s5_p1: Depending on where you live, you have some or all of the following rights:
privacy.s5_b1: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.s5_b2: Correction — ask us to fix anything that's wrong.
privacy.s5_b3: Deletion — ask us to delete your account and personal data. We may retain billing records as required by law.
privacy.s5_b4: Portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
privacy.s5_b5: Objection — opt out of certain uses, including anonymized analytics.
privacy.s5_b6: Withdraw consent — at any time, for processing that relies on consent.
privacy.s5_p2: To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@mapsly.ai from the email address on your account. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request. EU and UK residents may also lodge a complaint with their local supervisory authority.
privacy.s6_p1: We keep account data for as long as your account is active. After cancellation, we retain billing records for 7 years (US tax law) and delete the rest within 30 days. Server logs are retained for 30 days; usage analytics in aggregated form indefinitely.
privacy.s7_p1: Mapsly is operated from the United States. If you access the service from outside the US, your information will be transferred to and processed in the US under standard contractual clauses. We use industry-standard encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest, and follow least-privilege access for all internal systems.
privacy.s8_p1: We will post changes to this policy on this page and update the effective date. Material changes will be announced via email to active accounts at least 30 days in advance. For any privacy question, contact:

terms.subtitle: The agreement between you and Mapsly.
terms.s1_p1: By creating an account or using Mapsly, you agree to these Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy. If you are using Mapsly on behalf of a business or agency, you confirm you have the authority to bind that organization.
terms.s2_p1: You must provide accurate information when signing up and keep your contact email current. You are responsible for activity under your account, including any team members you invite. Tell us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access.
terms.s2_p2: Mapsly accounts are for organizations and the individuals operating them. Do not share login credentials. Each team member gets their own seat under your plan.
terms.s3_b1: Use Mapsly to violate any law or third-party right.
terms.s3_b2: Scrape, mirror, or republish our index of businesses outside the service.
terms.s3_b3: Use prospect contact data for unsolicited bulk outreach (spam). Mapsly stops at "qualified lead" — outreach itself is your responsibility, governed by your jurisdiction's anti-spam laws.
terms.s3_b4: Reverse-engineer or attempt to extract our scoring formulas or signal logic.
terms.s3_b5: Misrepresent your identity, ownership of a business, or affiliation with another organization.
terms.s4_p1: Mapsly is sold on monthly subscriptions billed in advance via Stripe. Current pricing lives on the Pricing page. We may change pricing with at least 30 days' notice; existing subscriptions stay on their current rate until the next renewal.
terms.s4_p2: Cancel anytime in your account settings. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period — no partial refunds for unused days, except as required by law or by our 30-day money-back guarantee for new accounts.
terms.s5_p1: You retain ownership of any content you upload (notes, list pitches, custom filters). You grant Mapsly a limited license to host, process, and display that content as needed to operate the service. We do not use your content to train external AI models.
terms.s5_p2: Aggregated, de-identified data about how the service is used may be retained indefinitely and used to improve Mapsly. This data cannot be linked back to you.
terms.s6_p1: We aim for 99.9% monthly uptime but do not guarantee it. Mapsly may have scheduled maintenance windows and may rely on third-party services (Stripe, Resend, DataForSEO) whose outages affect ours. We will make commercially reasonable efforts to restore service quickly.
terms.s7_p1: Mapsly is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. Our scores, rankings, and signal evaluations are estimates based on public data and may contain inaccuracies. Decisions you make based on Mapsly data are your responsibility.
terms.s7_p2: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Mapsly's total liability for any claim arising from your use of the service is limited to the amount you paid Mapsly in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
terms.s8_p1: You may close your account anytime in settings. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, fail to pay, or pose a risk to other users or our infrastructure. On termination, your access ends and we delete your personal data per our retention schedule.
terms.s9_p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, USA, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles. Any dispute will be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Delaware, unless your local law gives you the right to bring it elsewhere.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.subtitle: What cookies Mapsly uses and how to control them.
cookies.s1_p1: Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. They let us remember things between pages (like the fact that you're signed in) and measure how the service is used. Some cookies are required for Mapsly to work; others are optional.
cookies.s2_p1: Mapsly uses a small set of cookies, grouped by purpose:
cookies.s2_essential_p1: These are always on and cannot be disabled — without them, you cannot sign in or stay signed in.
cookies.s2_essential_b1: next-auth.session-token: keeps you signed in. Expires when you sign out or after 30 days of inactivity.
cookies.s2_essential_b2: next-auth.csrf-token: protects sign-in forms from cross-site request forgery.
cookies.s2_essential_b3: NEXT_LOCALE: remembers your chosen language. Expires after one year.
cookies.s2_analytics_p1: These help us understand how Mapsly is used in aggregate. They do not identify you personally.
cookies.s2_analytics_b1: _ga, _ga_*: Google Analytics 4 — anonymized page views, traffic source. Expires after 13 months.
cookies.s2_analytics_b2: Our own product-event tracker: which dashboard tiles you open. Session-only.
cookies.s2_third_party_p1: When you pay through Stripe, Stripe sets cookies on its checkout pages for fraud prevention. We do not control these. See Stripe's cookie policy at stripe.com/cookies-policy.
cookies.s3_p1: You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies will break sign-in. Blocking analytics cookies has no effect on what features you can use.
cookies.s3_p2: We will respect the "Do Not Track" signal from your browser by not loading analytics cookies if it is enabled.
cookies.s4_p1: If we add or remove cookies, we will update this page and bump the effective date. Material changes will be announced via email to active accounts.

faq.title: Quick answers.
faq.q1: Where does your data come from?
faq.a1: Google Maps, Search Console, Yelp, BBB, Trustpilot, Meta Ad Library, your website (Lighthouse), Reddit, job boards, certificate transparency, WHOIS, and 20+ other sources. Everything we use is either an official API or publicly observable. No scraping behind logins.
faq.q2: Is the free report really free?
faq.a2: Yes. One full report per business, no signup required. You see your rank, top 3 gaps, and your competitor breakdown. Paid plans unlock weekly refresh, alerts, more competitor detail, and the AI review-responder.
faq.q3: How is this different from other reputation tools?
faq.a3: Most tools tell you about your own reviews. Mapsly tells you how you compare to every competitor in your city — with the names, the reasons, and the fixes. No sales call. No annual contract. Cancel anytime.
faq.q4: What cities and verticals are covered?
faq.a4: At launch: med spa, HVAC, real estate, chiropractor, vet, roofing, plumbing, auto repair — across the top 30 metros in the US and Canada. Expanding to 65 metros and 20+ verticals through Year 1. You can request coverage of a vertical or city from inside the product.
faq.q5: Will my data be sold to anyone?
faq.a5: We use publicly observable signals only. When you sign up as a business, you opt into our network. Agencies see your business in lead searches if you match their criteria — that's the deal that funds your $29/mo. You can opt out of agency surfacing at any time.

faq.title: Quick answers.
faq.a1: Every contact is SMTP-verified at scrape time and re-verified weekly. Bounces drop the contact from the list. We hash & cache verification results 14 days. Verified contacts have a green dot in the UI; unverified are quarantined.
faq.a2: Profile data + Lighthouse + SERP: weekly (Sunday → Monday 06:00 ET). New reviews + Meta ad activity: daily. Keyword volume + market census: monthly. Every list shows a per-row last-refreshed timestamp.
faq.q3: Can I pitch the same SMB across multiple lists?
faq.a3: Yes. Lists are just saved filter sets — they don't own the prospect. The Hunter UI surfaces an 'already in N of your lists' badge so you don't double-pitch from two seats on the same account.
faq.q4: Do you replace Apollo or sit beside it?
faq.a4: Beside, usually. Apollo gives you scale + sequencing. Mapsly gives you intent + verification. The pattern that works: filter Mapsly for a tight signal-based shortlist, push to your existing sequencer (Smartlead, Instantly, Lemlist). Reply rates jump 3-6x.
faq.a5: We stop at the qualified lead. No outreach automation, no sequence builder, no inbox, no CRM. We integrate with the tools you already use (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Close, Smartlead) via push or CSV.

faq.title: What owners ask before signing up.
faq.q1: Is the free report really free?
faq.a1: Yes. Type your business name, we'll show you the report in 30 seconds. No card, no signup. Most owners look at it once and either close the tab or sign up — both fine.
faq.q2: Will my competitors see my data?
faq.a2: No. The data we pull is what's already public (Google reviews, listings, search results). We add structure and context only you see. Your private dashboard stays private.
faq.q3: How long until I see results?
faq.a3: Week one: you'll know your score, your ranking, and the customers you're losing. Week two: most owners reply to a backlog of reviews and see a small bump. Week four: if you've worked through three weekly fix lists, your score moves up a tier.
faq.q4: I'm not technical. Can I actually use this?
faq.a4: Yes. There's no setup, no integrations to wire up. We pull what's already on Google. You read a 5-minute email every Monday and tap a few buttons. That's the whole job.
faq.q5: What if I want to cancel?
faq.a5: One click in settings. We'll prorate the month. If you cancel within 30 days, full refund — no email required, no "what could we do better" form. We just hit refund.

faq.title: Pricing questions, answered.
faq.q1: What's the difference between the SMB plan and the agency tiers?
faq.a1: The SMB plan is for one local business owner watching their own spa, restaurant, or shop. The agency tiers are for marketing shops finding qualified leads for many SMBs at once. Different jobs, different software, different price.
faq.a2: Yes. Move up or down at any billing cycle from your settings page. Mid-cycle upgrades are prorated; downgrades take effect at the next renewal so you don't lose what you've paid for.
faq.q3: What counts as a "qualified lead" on the agency tiers?
faq.a3: A business that passes the filters you set in Hunter — for example "med-spa in Miami with reply rate below 25% and at least 100 reviews". You see the count live before you save the list, so there are no surprise overages.
faq.q4: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.a4: Growth, Pro, and Boutique each include a 14-day trial — full access, no card required up front. Solo skips the trial because the $49 tier is already the lowest commitment in the category. SMB owners get a free reality check before the $29/mo kicks in.
faq.q5: I need an invoice / wire / annual contract.
faq.a5: Boutique tier ships invoice billing and annual contracts by default. For Pro tier, email hello@mapsly.ai and we'll switch you over. Solo and Growth are credit-card monthly only — keeps overhead down so the price stays down.
